data.description:
## Context / Problem

Each prompt-eval spec in `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/*.eval.yaml` pins the model it generates with in a top-level `model:` key (for example `plan-review-finder.eval.yaml:11` is `anthropic:claude-opus-4-8`; `plan-review-evidence-kind.eval.yaml:5` is `bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6`), read by `rebar.llm.evals.eval` at `eval.py:308` (`gen_model = spec.get("model")`). After the configured models move to the 5.5 generation (sibling task `beaten-natural-grouse`), these pins would keep the prompt evals measuring the retired models, so the evals could not show whether the prompts still pass on the models that actually run.

## Approach

Move every spec pin to the 5.5 id of the same family and provider, keeping the provider each spec names: `anthropic:claude-opus-4-8` to `anthropic:claude-opus-5-5`, `anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6` to `anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5`, `bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6` to `bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5`, and any Haiku pin to `claude-haiku-5-5`. Run the prompt evals the `eval-live` job defines (`.github/workflows/prompt-eval.yml`: `rebar.llm.evals.eval.run_eval` over each dataset-bearing spec at `REBAR_EVAL_MAX_CASES=12`) once on the 4.x pins before the change and once on the 5.5 pins after, with `AWS_PROFILE=frontier-bedrock`, and record both summaries (spec, pass/fail, coverage) as a ticket comment. The commit is stacked on the upgrade task's commit (Gerrit parent), so it cannot land first, and the after-run is made on that stack because the 5.5 request-surface fixes (no temperature, explicit effort, corrected profile) must be in place for it to be meaningful; a one-to-one family mapping keeps each spec measuring the same tier it was calibrated on.

## Scope

- src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/*.eval.yaml (the `model:` line of each spec that pins a 4.x model; no other line changes)

## Testing

- `tests/unit` eval-discipline checks (the offline tier `_eval-discipline.yml` runs) pass, so spec validation still accepts every edited file.
- Live: the before and after prompt-eval runs described above.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `git grep -nE 'claude-(opus-4-8|sonnet-4-6|haiku-4-5)' -- src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/*.eval.yaml` prints nothing.
- [ ] The before (4.x) and after (5.5) prompt-eval summaries are recorded in a ticket comment, one line per spec with pass/fail and coverage.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Move prompt-eval spec model pins to the 5.5 ids and record before/after prompt evals
